correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ordered nonnegative representation count using n=aq+r, s=x+y+z=q-t, and u=r+at=y+2z. At fixed t the exact count is floor(u/2)-max(0,u-(q-t))+1 for 0<=u<=2(q-t); zero otherwise. The injection (x,y,z)->(x+1,y,z) implies d(n+a)>=d(n), so checking the displayed candidate g_p has exactly p representations and each of its a immediate successors >p proves the infinite bound. Algebraic residue subcases in RESULT.md establish this in three regimes 0<=p<=floor(a/2), floor(a/2)+1<=p<=a+1, a+2<=p<=2a for all a>=3. An independent coin-change DP independently checked g_p and all larger values within the computed range for all 4,347 pairs (a,p), 3<=a<=65.
